string-array.name: tut_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, feet together.
Make one straight line from head to heels — squeeze glutes, tighten belly.
Lower until your chest is about a fist above the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push the floor away back to the start.

string-array.name: tut_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging or sticking up
Elbows flaring straight out to the sides

resources.string: Hands on a table or sofa edge, or knees on the floor
Feet up on a chair

string-array.name: tut_squats_steps
string-array.item: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out a little.
Sit your hips back and down like onto a low chair, chest up.
Go down until thighs are about parallel to the floor, knees following your toes.
Push through the whole foot to stand up.

string-array.name: tut_squats_avoid
string-array.item: Heels lifting off the floor
Knees caving inward

resources.string: Squat down to touch a chair, then stand
Pause 2 s at the bottom

string-array.name: tut_plank_steps
string-array.item: Forearms on the floor, elbows right under your shoulders, forearms pointing forward.
Step your feet back so your body is a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes and brace your belly like someone is about to poke it.
Look at the floor and keep breathing.

string-array.name: tut_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips too high or sagging
Holding your breath

resources.string: Knees on the floor
Lift one foot a few centimetres

string-array.name: tut_glute_bridges_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, heels about a hand away from your bum.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until knees, hips and shoulders are in a line.
Squeeze your glutes for 1 s at the top.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: tut_glute_bridges_avoid
string-array.item: Arching the lower back instead of using glutes
Pushing through the toes

resources.string: Smaller lift
One leg at a time

string-array.name: tut_superman_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down, arms straight forward, legs straight.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor at the same time.
Keep looking at the floor so your neck stays long.
Hold and breathe.

string-array.name: tut_superman_avoid
string-array.item: Cranking the head up to look forward
Lifting so high it pinches the lower back

resources.string: Lift only arms, or only legs
Arms out in a Y shape

string-array.name: tut_reverse_lunges_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step back with one foot.
Lower until both knees are about 90°, back knee just above the floor.
Push through the front heel to step back up. Switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_reverse_lunges_avoid
string-array.item: Front knee caving inward
Leaning the upper body far forward

resources.string: Hold a wall or chair for balance
Wear a loaded backpack

string-array.name: tut_chair_dips_steps
string-array.item: Use a sturdy chair pushed against a wall. Sit on the edge, hands next to your hips, fingers forward.
Slide your bum off the front, feet flat and knees bent.
Bend your elbows straight back until they are about 90°.
Press back up.

string-array.name: tut_chair_dips_avoid
string-array.item: Shoulders shrugging up to the ears
Going so deep it hurts the front of the shoulder

resources.string: Feet closer to the chair
Legs straight

string-array.name: tut_pike_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in so your hips go high — an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor just in front of your hands.
Press back up to the V.

string-array.name: tut_pike_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Elbows flaring wide
Hips dropping so it turns into a normal push-up

resources.string: Smaller range
Feet up on a chair

string-array.name: tut_hollow_hold_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back. Press your lower back flat into the floor.
Lift your shoulders, arms reaching past your head.
Lift your straight legs a little off the floor — the body makes a shallow banana.
Hold. If your lower back lifts, raise your legs higher.

string-array.name: tut_hollow_hold_avoid
string-array.item: Lower back coming off the floor
Pulling on the neck

resources.string: Bend your knees and tuck them in
Lower arms and legs closer to the floor

string-array.name: tut_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide down until knees are about 90°.
Knees right above the ankles, arms off your thighs.
Hold and breathe.

string-array.name: tut_wall_sit_avoid
string-array.item: Knees ahead of the toes
Pushing on the thighs with your hands

resources.string: Sit higher on the wall
Lift one foot

string-array.name: tut_mountain_climbers_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank: hands under shoulders, body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, like running in place.
Keep your hips level. Each leg counts as one.

string-array.name: tut_mountain_climbers_avoid
string-array.item: Hips bouncing up high
Hands creeping forward

resources.string: Step the feet in slowly, one at a time
Go faster, or drive the knee toward the opposite elbow

string-array.name: tut_burpees_steps
string-array.item: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Jump or step your feet back in.
Jump up with your arms overhead.

string-array.name: tut_burpees_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging in the plank
Landing with stiff legs — land softly

resources.string: Step back and in, no jump
Add a push-up in the plank

string-array.name: tut_pullups_steps
string-array.item: Check the bar is securely mounted. Hang with hands a bit wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Pull your shoulder blades down first.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Lower all the way down slowly.

string-array.name: tut_pullups_avoid
string-array.item: Swinging or kicking for momentum
Half reps that stop short at the bottom

resources.string: Jump up, then lower yourself slowly over 3–5 s
Pause 2 s at the top

string-array.name: tut_wall_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Stand an arm\'s length from a wall, feet hip-width apart.
Put your hands on the wall at shoulder height, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight and bend your elbows until your nose nearly touches the wall.
Push the wall away to straighten your arms.

string-array.name: tut_wall_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sticking out behind you
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears

resources.string: Stand closer to the wall
Step your feet further back

string-array.name: tut_incline_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Put your hands on a sturdy counter or table edge, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push back up.

string-array.name: tut_incline_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: A table or chair that can slide or tip
Hips sagging

resources.string: Use a higher surface, like a kitchen counter
Use a lower surface, like a sofa seat

string-array.name: tut_knee_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Kneel on a soft surface and put your hands on the floor, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body is a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push back up.

string-array.name: tut_knee_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: Bending at the hips instead of keeping them in line
Elbows flaring straight out to the sides

resources.string: Hands on a sofa or table instead
Do the last reps with knees off the floor

string-array.name: tut_seated_leg_extensions_steps
string-array.item: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, hands on the seat.
Straighten one knee until the leg is out in front of you.
Pull your toes up toward you and hold for a second.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_seated_leg_extensions_avoid
string-array.item: Leaning back to lift the leg
Kicking the leg up quickly

resources.string: Straighten the knee only part of the way
Hold the straight leg for 3 seconds

string-array.name: tut_sit_to_stand_steps
string-array.item: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet flat, a bit apart.
Lean forward so your nose is over your toes.
Push through your heels and stand up all the way.
Sit back down slowly and with control.

string-array.name: tut_sit_to_stand_avoid
string-array.item: A chair with wheels or one that can slide
Dropping down onto the seat

resources.string: Push off your thighs or the armrests with your hands
Cross your arms over your chest

string-array.name: tut_standing_knee_raises_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall; hold a chair back or counter if you need balance.
Tighten your stomach as if bracing for a light poke.
Lift one knee toward hip height without leaning back.
Lower with control and switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_standing_knee_raises_avoid
string-array.item: Leaning back to get the knee higher
Holding your breath

resources.string: Lift the knee only as high as feels comfortable
Pause 2 s with the knee up, no hands

string-array.name: tut_incline_plank_steps
string-array.item: Put your forearms on a sturdy table or counter, elbows under your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is a straight line from head to heels.
Tighten your stomach and squeeze your buttocks.
Hold and breathe.

string-array.name: tut_incline_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging toward the floor
A table that can slide or tip

resources.string: Use a higher surface, like a kitchen counter
Use a lower surface, like a sofa seat

string-array.name: tut_wall_angels_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back, head and buttocks against a wall, feet a small step forward.
Raise your arms into a W: elbows bent, backs of the hands toward the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall as far as you can while keeping contact.
Slide back down to the W.

string-array.name: tut_wall_angels_avoid
string-array.item: Arching your lower back off the wall
Forcing the arms higher than is comfortable

resources.string: Let your hands come off the wall a little
Stand with your heels closer to the wall

string-array.name: tut_bird_dog_steps
string-array.item: Start on hands and knees: hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your body.
Hold for a second without letting the hips twist.
Bring them back and switch sides.

string-array.name: tut_bird_dog_avoid
string-array.item: Arching your back to lift the leg higher
Rushing from side to side

resources.string: Lift only the leg, or only the arm
Hold each rep for 3 seconds

string-array.name: tut_march_in_place_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lift one knee, then the other, at a steady pace.
Swing your arms in time with your legs.
Keep going for the whole time.

string-array.name: tut_march_in_place_avoid
string-array.item: Stomping hard on the floor
Holding your breath

resources.string: Lift the knees only a little, or hold a counter
Lift the knees higher and march faster

string-array.name: tut_step_jacks_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall, feet together, arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead.
Step back in as your arms come down.
Switch sides each rep. No jumping needed.

string-array.name: tut_step_jacks_avoid
string-array.item: Locking your knees
Swinging the arms so fast you lose balance

resources.string: Raise the arms only to shoulder height
Move faster, or do regular jumping jacks

string-array.name: tut_doorframe_rows_steps
string-array.item: Stand in an open doorway and grip both sides of the frame at chest height.
Walk your feet forward a little and lean back until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull your chest toward the frame.
Lower back slowly.

string-array.name: tut_doorframe_rows_avoid
string-array.item: A door that can swing into you – grip the frame, not the door
Letting the hips drop

resources.string: Stand more upright, feet further from the frame
Step your feet closer to the frame to lean back more

string-array.name: tut_jump_squats_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat until your thighs are about level with the floor, arms forward.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.

string-array.name: tut_jump_squats_avoid
string-array.item: Landing on straight, locked knees
Knees caving inward as you land

resources.string: Rise onto your toes instead of jumping
Pause for a second at the bottom of each squat

string-array.name: tut_table_rows_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back under a sturdy table, chest under its edge.
Grip the edge with both hands, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels and pull your chest up to the table.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: tut_table_rows_avoid
string-array.item: A light table that could tip over – test it first
Hips sagging toward the floor

resources.string: Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor
Pause at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades together

string-array.name: tut_standing_glute_kickbacks_steps
string-array.item: Stand facing the back of a sturdy chair and hold it lightly.
Lean forward a little and tighten your stomach.
Push one leg straight back, squeezing your buttock, without arching your lower back.
Bring it back slowly. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_standing_glute_kickbacks_avoid
string-array.item: Swinging the leg with momentum
Arching your lower back

resources.string: Make the movement smaller
Hold the top position for two seconds

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_glute_bridges_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot flat on the floor.
Straighten the other leg and lift it to the height of the bent knee.
Push through the heel on the floor and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Lower slowly. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_glute_bridges_avoid
string-array.item: Hips tipping to one side
Pushing through your toes instead of your heel

resources.string: Keep both feet down and shift your weight to one leg
Pause at the top for two seconds

string-array.name: tut_supported_reverse_lunges_steps
string-array.item: Stand next to a sturdy chair and hold its back with one hand.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your chest up.
Push through your front heel to step back up. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_supported_reverse_lunges_avoid
string-array.item: Leaning your weight on the chair
Front knee moving far past your toes

resources.string: Make the step and the dip shorter
Hold the chair with just your fingertips

string-array.name: tut_bulgarian_split_squats_steps
string-array.item: Stand a long step in front of a chair, with your back to it.
Put the top of one foot on the seat behind you.
Bend your front knee and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to rise. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_bulgarian_split_squats_avoid
string-array.item: A chair that can slide – put it against a wall
Front knee caving inward

resources.string: Use a lower step, such as a stair
Lower slowly, counting to three

string-array.name: tut_high_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back against a wall, feet a short step out in front.
Slide down until your knees are slightly bent, as if perching on a high stool.
Keep your back flat against the wall and hold.
Slide back up when the time is up.

string-array.name: tut_high_wall_sit_avoid
string-array.item: Knees moving past your toes
Holding your breath

resources.string: Slide down less
Slide lower, toward a normal wall sit

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Get into a normal wall sit, thighs about level with the floor.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Straighten the other leg out in front of you and hold.
Put the foot down and repeat with the other leg.

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_wall_sit_avoid
string-array.item: Hips twisting away from the wall
Standing knee caving inward

resources.string: Lift the foot only just off the floor
Sit lower

string-array.name: tut_seated_dips_steps
string-array.item: Sit on a sturdy chair without wheels, hands on the seat beside your hips.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press down through your hands and straighten your arms to lift your hips a little off the seat.
Lower back down slowly.

string-array.name: tut_seated_dips_avoid
string-array.item: Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears
A chair with wheels

resources.string: Help a little with your legs
Hold the lifted position for two seconds

string-array.name: tut_bent_knee_chair_dips_steps
string-array.item: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and grip the front of the seat beside your hips.
Walk your feet forward a little, knees at a right angle, and slide off the seat.
Bend your elbows straight back to lower your hips.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: tut_bent_knee_chair_dips_avoid
string-array.item: Elbows flaring out to the sides
Going so low that your shoulders hurt

resources.string: Make the dip shallower
Walk your feet further out

string-array.name: tut_seated_lean_backs_steps
string-array.item: Sit near the front of a chair or stool, feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest and sit tall.
Lean back slowly with a straight back until you feel your stomach working.
Hold, then sit back up.

string-array.name: tut_seated_lean_backs_avoid
string-array.item: Rounding your back
Holding your breath

resources.string: Lean back less
Lean further back

string-array.name: tut_tuck_hollow_hold_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and feet off the floor, knees pulled in over your hips, arms reaching toward your knees.
Hold, keeping your lower back on the floor.

string-array.name: tut_tuck_hollow_hold_avoid
string-array.item: Lower back lifting off the floor
Pulling on your neck

resources.string: Keep your feet on the floor
Straighten your legs a little

string-array.name: tut_squat_reaches_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat as low as feels comfortable, arms forward.
Stand up briskly and reach both arms overhead, rising onto your toes.
Keep a steady pace without stopping.

string-array.name: tut_squat_reaches_avoid
string-array.item: Heels lifting in the squat
Rounding your back at the bottom

resources.string: Squat less deep
Add a small hop at the top

string-array.name: tut_incline_burpees_steps
string-array.item: Stand facing a sturdy chair seat or a counter.
Put your hands on the edge and step your feet back one at a time into a straight plank.
Step your feet back in one at a time.
Stand up and reach your arms overhead.

string-array.name: tut_incline_burpees_avoid
string-array.item: A chair that can slide – put it against a wall
Hips sagging in the plank

resources.string: Use a higher surface, such as a counter
Jump your feet back and in

string-array.name: tut_incline_pike_pushups_steps
string-array.item: Put your hands on the seat of a sturdy chair, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet in and lift your hips high, so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the seat.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: tut_incline_pike_pushups_avoid
string-array.item: A chair that can slide – put it against a wall
Hips dropping so it turns into a push-up

resources.string: Use a higher surface, such as a counter
Do them on the floor (pike push-ups)

string-array.name: tut_hip_hinges_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and tip your chest forward with a flat back until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your buttocks to stand back up.

string-array.name: tut_hip_hinges_avoid
string-array.item: Rounding your back
Turning it into a squat by bending your knees a lot

resources.string: Tip forward less
Hold the bottom position for two seconds

string-array.name: tut_supported_single_leg_hinges_steps
string-array.item: Stand next to a sturdy chair and hold its back with one hand.
Stand on one leg, knee slightly bent.
Tip your chest forward as the other leg reaches straight back, until your body is nearly level.
Squeeze your buttock to come back up. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_supported_single_leg_hinges_avoid
string-array.item: Hips twisting open toward the ceiling
Rounding your back

resources.string: Keep the back toes touching the floor
Hold the chair with just your fingertips

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_deadlifts_steps
string-array.item: Stand on one leg, knee slightly bent, arms hanging down.
Tip your chest forward as the other leg reaches straight back.
Lower your hands toward the floor until your body is nearly level.
Squeeze your buttock to come back up. Do all reps, then switch legs.

string-array.name: tut_single_leg_deadlifts_avoid
string-array.item: Hips twisting open toward the ceiling
Rushing and losing your balance

resources.string: Hold on to a chair (supported single-leg hinges)
Hold a full water bottle in your hands

string-array.name: tut_wall_side_plank_steps
string-array.item: Stand side-on to a wall, about a step away.
Put your forearm on the wall at shoulder height, elbow under your shoulder.
Lean into the wall with your body straight from head to feet, pushing your hips away from the wall.
Hold, then do the same time on the other side.

string-array.name: tut_wall_side_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging toward the wall
Shrugging your shoulder up to your ear

resources.string: Stand closer to the wall
Step your feet further from the wall

string-array.name: tut_knee_side_plank_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and your knees bent behind you.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from head to knees.
Hold without letting your hips drop.
Then do the same time on the other side.

string-array.name: tut_knee_side_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging or pushing back
Shrugging your shoulder up to your ear

resources.string: Make the hold shorter
Straighten your legs (side plank)

string-array.name: tut_side_plank_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder, legs straight and feet stacked.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from head to feet.
Reach your top arm toward the ceiling and hold.
Then do the same time on the other side.

string-array.name: tut_side_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Hips sagging toward the floor
Rolling forward or backward

resources.string: Put your top foot in front of the bottom one
Lift your top leg a little

string-array.name: tut_standing_crossbody_knees_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Bring the opposite elbow down to meet it, tightening your stomach.
Return and switch sides each rep.

string-array.name: tut_standing_crossbody_knees_avoid
string-array.item: Pulling on your head with your hands
Hunching over instead of twisting

resources.string: Lift the knee less and hold a chair with one hand
Go faster while staying in control

string-array.name: tut_seated_knee_tucks_steps
string-array.item: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and hold the sides of the seat.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Straighten your legs forward, then pull your knees in toward your chest.
Keep your back straight the whole time.

string-array.name: tut_seated_knee_tucks_avoid
string-array.item: Rounding your back
A chair that can tip backward

resources.string: Keep one foot on the floor and alternate legs
Lean further back

string-array.name: tut_bicycle_crunches_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and feet off the floor.
Bring one knee in as the other leg straightens, turning the opposite elbow toward the bent knee.
Switch sides in a steady, pedalling rhythm.

string-array.name: tut_bicycle_crunches_avoid
string-array.item: Pulling on your neck
Lower back arching off the floor

resources.string: Keep your feet higher and go slower
Straighten the leg lower, closer to the floor
